title: 3690. Split and Merge Array Transformation

examples.explanation: Split out the subarray [3] (L = 0, R = 0); the remaining array is [1,2]. Insert [3] at the end; the array becomes [1,2,3].

Remove [1,1,2] at indices 0 - 2; remaining is [3,4,5]; insert [1,1,2] at position 2, resulting in [3,4,1,1,2,5]. Remove [4,1,1] at indices 1 - 3; remaining is [3,2,5]; insert [4,1,1] at position 3, resulting in [3,2,5,4,1,1]. Remove [3,2] at indices 0 - 1; remaining is [5,4,1,1]; insert [3,2] at position 2, resulting in [5,4,3,2,1,1].
